method_definition.name: equal-weight regional SNP-RKHS
method_definition.standardization: Reuse core.indicators and core.standardized: training-only biallelic MAF>0.05, training minor-code convention, population SD, same standardized retained SNPs as SNP linear. Query genotypes never estimate preprocessing.
method_definition.window_kernel_formula: R_w(i,j;gamma) = exp(-gamma * sum_{s in retained(w)} (z_is-z_js)^2 / p_w), p_w=number of training-retained, nonconstant SNPs in w
method_definition.normalization_formula: K_train = H R_train H / [trace(H R_train H)/n]; K_query uses only training column means, training grand mean and training trace scale
method_definition.normalization_order: Average RAW RBF kernels across windows BEFORE a single training-only centering/trace normalization; do not normalize individual windows.
method_definition.window_weighting: Equal weight per nonempty training-retained window, irrespective of SNP count. Windows with no retained SNPs are excluded; windows are NOT filtered by mean-dosage variability.
method_definition.window_boundaries: Reuse core outcome-independent reference coordinates: subdivide base at-most-25-SNP/50kb windows for 5/10, retain for 25, merge two/four adjacent same-chromosome base windows for 50/100. Scale is not a guaranteed physical width or post-MAF retained count.
method_definition.difference_from_core_local: Core local kernel acts on standardized window-mean dosage; this module uses full standardized within-window SNP vectors and genuine nonlinear RBFs for all nine gamma values.
method_definition.selection: Joint scale x gamma x lambda selection by pooled 5-inner-fold validation MSE inside each of 10 x 5 outer splits, with identical core seeds and penalty grid.
scope_limits: A transparent equal-weight regional SNP-RKHS baseline, not exact MKLMM, MultiBLUP, or Akdemir & Jannink reproduction.
No estimated region weights, sparsity, variance-component learning, or separate chromosome kernels; no cross-window interactions are explicitly modeled.
Within-window SNP information is preserved, but predictive performance alone does not establish biological epistasis or causal interactions.
Repeat variability is split variability, not ten independent biological replications; no independent significance claim is made.
This task evaluates the existing dormancy training cohort only, not external cohorts; all completed results are retained irrespective of direction.

Float32 distances/RBF exponentials with float64 accumulation can produce roundoff-level deviations from exact PSD; the unchanged core solver thresholds eigenvalues. Float64 oracle and real-data tests quantify this.

protocol.scope: Major revision; original inputs and manuscript are read-only. All new outputs are kept in this directory.
protocol.selection_loss: pooled inner-validation mean squared error; no outer-test outcome is used for selection
protocol.window_rule: Reuse core outcome-independent reference coordinates: subdivide base at-most-25-SNP/50kb windows for 5/10, retain for 25, merge two/four adjacent same-chromosome base windows for 50/100. Scale is not a guaranteed physical width or post-MAF retained count.
protocol.fair_ablation: Use exactly the legacy 202747 marker indices and 83-accession allele indicators for SNP, regional linear and local Gaussian models; fixed reference window 25. Match the legacy folds and hyperparameter choices where reproducing old numbers, and distinguish this ablation from fully inductive evaluation.
protocol.strict_preprocessing: Reuse core.indicators and core.standardized: training-only biallelic MAF>0.05, training minor-code convention, population SD, same standardized retained SNPs as SNP linear. Query genotypes never estimate preprocessing.
primary_comparisons: equal-weight regional SNP-RKHS versus identical SNP linear companion
protocol.additional_comparisons: Descriptive comparison with saved core window-mean local Gaussian, without rerunning or selecting that baseline.
metrics: calibration slope: observed regressed on predictions
protocol.uncertainty: Repeat metrics describe split variability, not independent biological replications. Report paired differences and conditional accession/ancestry-cluster bootstrap intervals with explicit limitations; retain Nadeau-Bengio only as approximate sensitivity. Add a training-refitted robustness analysis rather than treating saved predictions as covering training-set uncertainty. Phenotype signal tests are distinct from model-superiority tests.
protocol.external_policy: Freeze all model selection using the training cohort only. Audit overlaps by canonical genotype column/ecotype ID, not names alone. Do not optimize models on external outcomes.
protocol.robustness: Retain all accessions in the main analysis. Prespecified sensitivity leaves out the single maximum-DSDS50 accession and reports its identity; do not search for favorable exclusions.
protocol.disclosure: This protocol was set for the revision after reading reviewer comments; it is not prospectively registered before the original study. Report all completed outcomes irrespective of direction.
